newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ visitor arrivals rise 6 pct in Sept vs Sept '95.
newsitem.headline: NZ visitor arrivals rise 6 pct in Sept vs Sept '95.

text.p: Visitor arrivals to New Zealand were up six percent in the September year compared with September 1995, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
During the year, overseas arrivals totalled 1.488 million, up eight percent on the September 1995 year.
Short-term travel by New Zealanders overseas rose 29 percent over the same period. However, the department said the rise may be due to the change in school holiday dates as well as lower airfares.
After adjusting for seasonal variations, the number of overseas visitor arrivals dropped two percent between August and September.
There was a net gain of 2,340 permanent and long-term migrants in September. In the year there was a net gain of 27,270 migrants, up four percent over the previous September year gain.
